title: Aanpassing na verhuizing 1968
authors: Clemens Schroner, B.L.F., Boer, R.A. de, Buikhuisen, W., Ackermans, E., Nederlands instituut voor praeventieve geneeskunde, NIPG TNO * Leiden (primary investigator)
contributors: Nederlands instituut voor praeventieve geneeskunde, NIPG * Leiden (data collector)
descriptions: Studying the adaptation process after moving to other house. Influence of moving on parents and children / adaptation / belonging to a group / family life ( atmosphere, authority, mutual interest and support ) / relations with children / neighbourhood / leisure time / hobbies / housekeeping / job / school attitude / children, family life / relations with siblings and parents, friends / leisure time / school / teacher and pupils, children's new teachers / the child's behaviour at school. Background variables: basic characteristics/ housing situation/ household characteristics/ social class/ readership, mass media, and 'cultural' exposure/ organizational membership
